title: Successive adjoining of etale sections
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring. Starting with $R_0=R$, choose, for each $n$, a set $S_n$ containing one representative of every isomorphism class of faithfully flat $R_n$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] that are etale (meaning that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R_n$ is etale in [def-weil-etale-morphism], with spectrum as in [def-weil-affine-spectrum]) and of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Representatives are chosen in a fixed universe throughout.

The coproducts of commutative base algebras and the small colimits of commutative rings used below exist by [lem-weil-pbc-commutative-algebras-colimits-exist]; colimit notation and canonical maps are as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

For each finite subset $E\subseteq S_n$, let $B_{n,E}=\bigotimes_{B\in E,R_n}B$ be the coproduct in commutative $R_n$-algebras: maps $B_{n,E}\to D$ of $R_n$-algebras correspond to families of $R_n$-algebra maps $B\to D$ for $B\in E$. For $E=\varnothing$ this is $R_n$. If $E\subseteq E'$, use the map $B_{n,E}\to B_{n,E'}$ induced by the canonical maps of the factors; on pure tensors it adjoins $1$ in each new factor. Define $R_{n+1}=\varinjlim_{E\subseteq S_n,\ E\text{ finite}}B_{n,E}$, with structural map $R_n\to R_{n+1}$ induced by the empty subset. This is the meaning of the arbitrary tensor product over $R_n$ of all the chosen representatives.

Set $R^{\mathrm e}=\varinjlim_{n\in\mathbf N}R_n$ using these structural maps. Each colimit is taken in commutative rings, with its canonical ring maps: maps from it to any commutative ring $D$ correspond to families of ring maps from the terms to $D$ compatible with the transition maps. Thus both colimits specify actual rings by their universal properties, up to the unique isomorphism respecting their canonical maps.
